_readme: Website legal pages. Source of truth: Photografik_Studios_Website_Terms_and_Licensing.docx (James, Sep 30 2026; effective September 30, 2026). The text must be copied from that document verbatim in substance (formatting for web readability only; no rewriting, summarising or older terms). Order follows OWNER_LEGAL_HIERARCHY_2026-09-30.md: Photografik / general policies first, then a clearly labelled Creator Studios, Podcast & Studio supplement; sections are numbered continuously. Each section's 'blocks' are filled from the document: {type:'p',text} | {type:'ul'|'ol',items} | {type:'h3',text} | {type:'table',head:[...],rows:[[...]]}; inline **bold** and [links](/path) allowed. 'ready' may be set true only when every section is filled from the document and the source checksum is recorded. Until then production builds are blocked and review builds show the page structure with a dev-only placeholder.
